text:
Taylor: Plant swap + microbrew tasting + 20-min charades? Patio, Friday 6pm. Bring a cutting or a tiny pot. Low-key prizes. Who's down? :seedling::beer::performing_arts:
Sam: Love it. I can bring a 6-pack of local cans and a small hop-forward tasting flight. :beers:
Ava: I'm in for the plant swap but allergic to hops 11 I'll bring a citrus non-alc option.
Jordan: Quick Q: any risk with live plants on the patio? facilities ok with it?
Priya: I can check with facilities for plant rules and noise curfew. Also I have extra small pots if someone needs one.
Taylor: @Priya amazing, thanks. @Sam can you share cost estimate for tasting? If it's small we can ask social budget or do pay-at-table.
Sam: Roughly $30-$40 for a 6-sample flight for 6 people. I can split if budget's tight.
poll-bot: Poll created  Choose date: 1) Fri 6pm 2) Sat 4pm 3) Mon 7pm. React with :one::two::three: to vote.
Taylor: React with :seedling: if youre swapping a plant, and :busts_in_silhouette: if you're bringing a +1.
Jordan: :one: and :seedling: I have a small spider plant to swap.
Priya: :one: and I can bring extra pots.
Ava: :two: prefer Saturday morning but can do Friday if needed. No guest.
Sam: :one: and possibly +1.
poll-bot: Current votes  Fri(3), Sat(1), Mon(0). Fri leading.
Priya: Facilities okayed live plants and patio use until 9pm on Fridays. Just asked for a quick heads-up note to neighbors.
Taylor: Great. If finance covers tasting up to $50, we can keep it free; @Jordan can you check? If not, we'll do pay-at-sample.
Jordan: I'll ping finance now.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Potted & Pint-sized: Plant Swap + Microbrew" Fri 6pm  RSVP open
Taylor: Perfect. I'll post RSVP form and a tiny swap guide (label pots, small roots only). Also will bring markers and sticky notes for plant names.
Ava: I'll bring citrus mocktail + napkins.
Sam: I'll bring the tasting flight and three snack platters. If finance covers tasting, I can bill company; otherwise split via Venmo.
Priya: I'll bring extra pots and a small watering can.
Taylor: Sweet. Thanks everyone :seedling::sparkles:
